lines.zh: 我沿着河底往上游走，逆着流。
lines.en: I work upstream along the riverbed, against the flow.

lines.zh: 水浑得看不见，我靠鼻子走。
lines.en: The water is too murky to see; I follow my nose.

lines.zh: 河水和海水我都能待，谁拦我。
lines.en: River or sea, I can live in both; who stops me?

lines.zh: 我贴着泥底游，不看上面。
lines.en: I keep to the muddy bottom and ignore the surface.

lines.zh: 身体粗，转弯慢，但撞得开。
lines.en: I am thick, slow to turn, but I shove through.

lines.zh: 我顺着河口游进淡水，一点不怕。
lines.en: I swim up the estuary into fresh water, unafraid.

lines.zh: 这条河很窄，我几乎填满它。
lines.en: This river is narrow; I nearly fill it.

lines.zh: 我经过码头木桩，木头被我蹭响。
lines.en: I pass the dock pilings and the wood creaks.

lines.zh: 泥里翻起一团浑，那是我的路。
lines.en: A cloud of silt rises behind me; that is my road.

lines.zh: 我从深潭穿到浅滩，没有停。
lines.en: From pool to shoal I go without stopping.

lines.zh: 背很宽，水在我上面流过去。
lines.en: My back is broad; water flows over it.

lines.zh: 我浮在上层，背鳍划开河面。
lines.en: I ride high, dorsal fin splitting the river surface.

lines.zh: 我闻到海水，说明快到海口了。
lines.en: I smell salt; the river mouth is near.

lines.zh: 我一步一沉，像在泥里走路。
lines.en: Each stroke sinks me, as if walking in mud.

lines.zh: 我游过一片沙洲，沙扬起来。
lines.en: I cross a sandbar and it clouds up.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，从船底穿过去。
lines.en: I sink low and pass under the boat.

lines.zh: 浑水里有血腥味，我跟着。
lines.en: Blood in the murk. I follow it.

lines.zh: 鳍尖划开水面，留下一道线。
lines.en: My fin tip cuts the surface, leaving a line.

lines.zh: 我停在深潭里，水几乎不流。
lines.en: I rest in the deep pool where the water hardly moves.

lines.zh: 我张嘴吸水，滤出味道。
lines.en: I gape to draw water and sift its taste.

lines.zh: 泥底有螃蟹在动，我不理。
lines.en: Crabs move on the mud; I ignore them.

lines.zh: 我慢慢摆尾，保持身体不沉。
lines.en: I sweep my tail slowly to stay off the bottom.

lines.zh: 河面上有船，我沉到下面。
lines.en: A boat passes overhead; I sink below it.

lines.zh: 我闻到了血，来自上游一点。
lines.en: I smell blood, a little way upstream.

lines.zh: 这潭水暖和，我喜欢。
lines.en: This pool is warm; I like it.

lines.zh: 我绕着潭底走了一圈。
lines.en: I make one lap of the pool floor.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛很小，看不远。
lines.en: My eyes are small; I do not see far.

lines.zh: 我在等水退，好过浅滩。
lines.en: I wait for the water to fall so I can cross the shoal.

lines.zh: 身上的泥干了又湿，一层。
lines.en: The mud on me dries and wets, a layer at a time.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，水面离我一尺。
lines.en: I raise my head; the surface is a foot away.

lines.zh: 我什么都不做，只是占着这里。
lines.en: I do nothing but hold this stretch.

lines.zh: 河湾里安静，我不喜欢安静。
lines.en: The bend is quiet; I do not like quiet.

lines.zh: 你在岸上走，我贴着那一侧。
lines.en: You walk the bank; I keep to that side.

lines.zh: 我抬头出水面，先看你的手。
lines.en: I lift my head out and look at your hands first.

lines.zh: 你把网放下，我退进泥影里。
lines.en: You lower a net; I back into the silt shadow.

lines.zh: 我那双小眼睛盯住你的脚踝。
lines.en: My small eyes fix on your ankles.

lines.zh: 你站在浅水，水只到我肚。
lines.en: You stand in water only to my belly.

lines.zh: 我绕过去，从下游回到你面前。
lines.en: I circle and come back at you from downstream.

lines.zh: 我不吼，只是把头抬高一点。
lines.en: I do not roar; I simply raise my head.

lines.zh: 你的船桨声让我记住了位置。
lines.en: Your oars let me remember where you are.

lines.zh: 你看不见水下，我全看得见。
lines.en: You cannot see under the water; I see all of it.

lines.zh: 我们互相看着，谁先动谁吃亏。
lines.en: We watch each other; whoever moves first loses.

lines.zh: 刀砍进我的背，皮厚也挡不住。
lines.en: The blade sinks into my back; thick hide is not enough.

lines.zh: 我猛地转身，撞翻了水里的东西。
lines.en: I spin hard and knock over whatever is in the water.

lines.zh: 血流进泥里，水更浑了。
lines.en: Blood runs into the mud and the water thickens.

lines.zh: 我退到深潭，那里能藏身。
lines.en: I fall back to the deep pool where I can hide.

lines.zh: 这一下让我发狠，不是害怕。
lines.en: This makes me vicious, not frightened.

lines.zh: 我顶着伤口往上游，不回头。
lines.en: I push upstream past the wound, not looking back.

lines.zh: 你砍中鳍，我游得歪了一点。
lines.en: You catch a fin; my swimming goes crooked.

lines.zh: 我在泥里蹭，用泥盖住血味。
lines.en: I roll in the mud to cover the smell of blood.

lines.zh: 痛让我更想咬住不放。
lines.en: The pain makes me want to hold on harder.

lines.zh: 你最好现在就上岸。
lines.en: You had better get on the bank now.

lines.zh: 血腥味一散开，我就顶着水上来。
lines.en: Blood spreads and I push up through the water.

lines.zh: 你扔下的鱼还没沉底，我咬住了。
lines.en: Your fish has not reached bottom before I take it.

lines.zh: 我闻得到桶里的东西，别盖太紧。
lines.en: I smell what is in the bucket; do not lid it tight.

lines.zh: 河水把味道拉得很长，我顺着走。
lines.en: The river draws the scent long; I follow it.

lines.zh: 我不挑，鱼、蟹、死肉都吃。
lines.en: I am not picky: fish, crab, carrion.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子顶到桶边，撞了一下。
lines.en: I press my snout to the bucket and bump it.

lines.zh: 手伸下来，我会先试一口。
lines.en: A hand comes down and I will test it first.

lines.zh: 这一口吞下，我盯着下一口。
lines.en: One gulp, and I watch for the next.

lines.zh: 你把食物扔远，我才不吃你。
lines.en: Throw the food wide, and I will not eat you.

lines.zh: 吃饱了，我还想再闻一次。
lines.en: Full, I still want to smell it once more.

lines.zh: 我先用头撞你，这是规矩。
lines.en: I bump you with my head first; that is the rule.

lines.zh: 你被我顶得后退，水花四溅。
lines.en: My shove knocks you back, water flying.

lines.zh: 我皮厚，撞木桩都不疼。
lines.en: My hide is thick; pilings do not hurt me.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你比我轻得多。
lines.en: We collide; you are far lighter than I am.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的腿擦过去，很用力。
lines.en: I scrape past your leg, hard.

lines.zh: 你别拍水，那会让我更想撞。
lines.en: Do not slap the water; it makes me want to hit.

lines.zh: 我撞完就退开，先看看反应。
lines.en: I bump, then pull back to see the reaction.

lines.zh: 河底泥被我们搅成一片黑。
lines.en: We churn the riverbed into black mud.

lines.zh: 你扶着船，我撞了一下船。
lines.en: You hold the boat; I strike the boat instead.

lines.zh: 我的肩很宽，躲不开也正常。
lines.en: My shoulders are broad; no dodging that.

lines.zh: 河口是养育的地方，我们聚在那儿。
lines.en: The estuary is where we gather to breed.

lines.zh: 淡水里幼鲨少些天敌，所以上来。
lines.en: Fresh water has fewer predators, so we come up.

lines.zh: 我用吻部顶她的腹，慢慢地。
lines.en: I butt her belly with my snout, slowly.

lines.zh: 配对时我留下深咬痕，她忍着。
lines.en: I leave deep bite marks; she endures them.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，两副宽背挤着。
lines.en: We swim abreast, two broad backs pressing.

lines.zh: 她进了浅湾，我就守在湾口。
lines.en: She enters the shallow bay; I guard its mouth.

lines.zh: 幼鲨在河湾里长，我在外圈转。
lines.en: Pups grow in the bend; I circle outside.

lines.zh: 别这时候下水，我们脾气最坏。
lines.en: Do not enter the water now; our tempers are worst.

lines.zh: 水一暖，成对的就多起来。
lines.en: As the water warms, pairs grow common.

lines.zh: 她游远了，我跟着水声。
lines.en: She swims off; I follow the sound of her.

lines.zh: 桶太小，我半个身子还在外面。
lines.en: The bucket is too small; half of me stays out.

lines.zh: 我撞桶壁，声音闷得像鼓。
lines.en: I hit the bucket wall; it booms like a drum.

lines.zh: 水不够深，我的鳃张得很大。
lines.en: Not enough water; my gills gape wide.

lines.zh: 被提起来时，我还在甩尾。
lines.en: Lifted out, I am still beating my tail.

lines.zh: 木板挡着我，我用头一直顶。
lines.en: Wood blocks me and I keep butting it.

lines.zh: 你们两个人抬，才抬得动我。
lines.en: It takes two of you to carry me.

lines.zh: 桶里的水很快就浑了。
lines.en: The water in the bucket muddies fast.

lines.zh: 我闻到河，就在下面不远。
lines.en: I smell the river, close beneath us.

lines.zh: 你倒我回水，我甩开一大片泥。
lines.en: Poured back, I throw up a sheet of mud.

lines.zh: 别把我扔在岸上晒太阳。
lines.en: Do not leave me on the bank in the sun.

lines.zh: 你在浅水里趟，动静太大了。
lines.en: You wade the shallows; you make too much noise.

lines.zh: 血顺流下来，我知道在上游。
lines.en: Blood comes downstream; I know it is upstream.

lines.zh: 有条鱼翻了肚，我过去看看。
lines.en: A fish floats belly up; I go to inspect.

lines.zh: 我闻到肉，方向就定了。
lines.en: I smell meat and my heading is decided.

lines.zh: 我不用看，水告诉我一切。
lines.en: I need not look; the water tells me everything.

lines.zh: 那头牛在河边喝水，太靠边了。
lines.en: That cow drinks at the bank, far too close.

lines.zh: 我掉头，逆着水往上。
lines.en: I turn and head up against the current.

lines.zh: 距离一近，我就压低身体。
lines.en: As the gap closes, I lower my body.

lines.zh: 这条河里，我先看上的是你。
lines.en: In this river, you are what I noticed first.

lines.zh: 别跑，跑动的水声最好追。
lines.en: Do not run; splashing is the easiest thing to track.

lines.zh: 我在浑水里跟着你，看不见也行。
lines.en: I follow you through the murk; sight is optional.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底走，从下面来。
lines.en: I keep to the riverbed and come from below.

lines.zh: 我先撞一下，再决定咬不咬。
lines.en: I bump first, then decide whether to bite.

lines.zh: 你往岸上退，我就停在浅边。
lines.en: You back toward the bank; I stop at the shallows.

lines.zh: 我数你的步子，很短的距离。
lines.en: I count your steps; the distance is short.

lines.zh: 水流向我，味道也向我。
lines.en: The current runs to me, and so does the scent.

lines.zh: 我绕到下游，堵住你回来的路。
lines.en: I swing downstream to block your way back.

lines.zh: 别站在齐腰的水里，那不聪明。
lines.en: Do not stand waist-deep; that is unwise.

lines.zh: 我不急，河水会把你送来。
lines.en: I am patient; the river will bring you.

lines.zh: 最后一圈，我就要开口了。
lines.en: One last circle, then I open my mouth.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住，牙是三角形的。
lines.en: I bite down with triangular teeth.

lines.zh: 我先撞翻你，再咬腿。
lines.en: I knock you over first, then bite the leg.

lines.zh: 这一口很重，我不是试探。
lines.en: This bite is heavy; it is no test.

lines.zh: 血在浑水里散开，看不见也没关系。
lines.en: Blood spreads in the murk; not seeing is fine.

lines.zh: 你拿刀砍我吻部，我退了半步。
lines.en: You slash my snout; I give half a step.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把咬住的东西扯下来。
lines.en: I wrench my head to tear loose what I hold.

lines.zh: 我咬完就绕开，不跟你硬拼。
lines.en: After biting I circle off, no straight brawl.

lines.zh: 淡水里的我，比海里的更凶。
lines.en: In fresh water I am meaner than at sea.

lines.zh: 你上了船，我顶着船底。
lines.en: You reach the boat; I push at its hull.

lines.zh: 这一下，你该记住这条河了。
lines.en: Now you will remember this river.

lines.zh: 我从河口的浑水里浮上来。
lines.en: I rise out of the murky river mouth.

lines.zh: 这条河的水是淡的，我照样游。
lines.en: This river runs fresh; I swim it all the same.

lines.zh: 我身体宽，水被我顶开。
lines.en: My body is broad and shoves the water aside.

lines.zh: 深潭到浅滩，都归我巡。
lines.en: From deep pool to shoal, all of it is mine to patrol.

lines.zh: 泥底翻了一下，那是我到了。
lines.en: The mud heaves once; that is my arrival.

lines.zh: 我不从海里来，我从上游来。
lines.en: I did not come from the sea; I came downstream.

lines.zh: 这里的水暖，正合我意。
lines.en: The water here is warm, exactly as I like.

lines.zh: 岸上的人还不知道我来了。
lines.en: The people on the bank do not know yet.

lines.zh: 我的背鳍先划开水面。
lines.en: My dorsal fin splits the surface first.

lines.zh: 河面很平静，那是我在下面。
lines.en: The river looks calm; that is me underneath.

lines.zh: 火在水面烧，我沉到泥上。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface; I sink to the mud.

lines.zh: 从高处掉下，我重重砸进水里。
lines.en: Falling from height, I crash heavily into water.

lines.zh: 我离了水，鳃贴在头上动不了。
lines.en: Out of water, my gills fold flat and useless.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，泥和水一起飞。
lines.en: A blast flips me, mud and water flying.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我背上，我照样往前。
lines.en: An arrow pins my back; I still push forward.

lines.zh: 魔法的光钻进泥水，刺得我发昏。
lines.en: Magic light pierces the muddy water and dazes me.

lines.zh: 河里没有吃的，我饿得发沉。
lines.en: Nothing to eat in this river; hunger weighs me down.

lines.zh: 雷打进河里，我整条都抽紧。
lines.en: Lightning enters the river and clenches me stiff.

lines.zh: 虚空把我往下扯，没有水托着。
lines.en: The void drags me down with no water to hold me.
